parameter.label: P_CODEMP : multiList:Text
parameter.expression: SELECT CODEMP AS VALUE ,CODEMP || ' - ' || RAZAOABREV AS LABEL FROM TSIEMP WHERE CODEMP < 100

chart.expression: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAB.NUNOTA) AS QTD_NOTAS ,'DENTRO DA REFORMA' AS SITUACAO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP AND (CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER OR :P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL ) AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CCLASSTRIB IS NOT NULL AND DIN.CODIMP = 14 ) UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CAB.NUNOTA) AS QTD_NOTAS ,'FORA DA REFORMA' AS SITUACAO FROM TGFCAB CAB INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER OR :P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL ) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CCLASSTRIB IS NOT NULL AND DIN.CODIMP = 14 )

grid.expression:
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.CODEMP ,CAB.CODTIPOPER ,TOP.DESCROPER ,CAB.NUFOP ,FOP.DESCRICAO ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,MAX(CAB.VLRNOTA) AS VLR_NOTA ,MAX(DIN.CODCST) AS CST ,MAX(DIN.CCLASSTRIB) AS CLASSIFICACAO ,SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 14 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_CBS ,SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 12 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_IBS
FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
INNER JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
LEFT JOIN TGFFOP FOP ON FOP.NUFOP = CAB.NUFOP
WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER OR :P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL ) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND 'DENTRO DA REFORMA' = :A_STATUS AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CCLASSTRIB IS NOT NULL AND DIN.CODIMP IN (12,14) )
GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.CODEMP ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,CAB.CODTIPOPER ,TOP.DESCROPER ,CAB.NUFOP ,FOP.DESCRICAO UNION ALL
SELECT CAB.NUNOTA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.CODEMP ,CAB.CODTIPOPER ,TOP.DESCROPER ,CAB.NUFOP ,FOP.DESCRICAO ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,MAX(CAB.VLRNOTA) AS VLR_NOTA ,MAX(DIN.CODCST) AS CST ,MAX(DIN.CCLASSTRIB) AS CLASSIFICACAO ,SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 14 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_CBS ,SUM(CASE WHEN DIN.CODIMP = 12 THEN DIN.VALOR ELSE 0 END) AS VLR_IBS
FROM TGFCAB CAB
INNER JOIN TGFITE ITE ON ITE.NUNOTA = CAB.NUNOTA
INNER JOIN TGFPAR PAR ON PAR.CODPARC = CAB.CODPARC
INNER JOIN TGFTOP TOP ON TOP.CODTIPOPER = CAB.CODTIPOPER AND TOP.DHALTER = CAB.DHTIPOPER
LEFT JOIN TGFDIN DIN ON DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA
LEFT JOIN TGFFOP FOP ON FOP.NUFOP = CAB.NUFOP
WHERE CAB.DTNEG >= :P_PERIODO.INI AND CAB.DTNEG <= :P_PERIODO.FIN AND (CAB.CODTIPOPER = :P_CODTIPOPER OR :P_CODTIPOPER IS NULL ) AND CAB.CODEMP IN :P_CODEMP AND CAB.STATUSNFE = 'A' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TGFDIN DIN WHERE DIN.NUNOTA = ITE.NUNOTA AND DIN.SEQUENCIA = ITE.SEQUENCIA AND DIN.CCLASSTRIB IS NOT NULL AND DIN.CODIMP IN(12, 14) ) AND 'FORA DA REFORMA' = :A_STATUS
GROUP BY CAB.NUNOTA ,CAB.NUMNOTA ,CAB.DTNEG ,CAB.CODEMP ,CAB.CODPARC ,PAR.NOMEPARC ,CAB.CODTIPOPER ,TOP.DESCROPER ,CAB.NUFOP ,FOP.DESCRICAO
